integrity: Exact all-parameter shell-orthogonality proof; standalone finite exact checker verifies representative cyclic and noncyclic rings, and does not purport to prove the unbounded theorem.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative chain rings only; exact zero-product indicator and unnormalized additive convolution only; a broad earlier association-scheme theorem may implicitly imply the class-specific spectrum; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: A universal nodal Fourier spectrum over finite chain rings
